name: arest-mcp-registry
description: The MCP router's own store: which apps it serves, where each package is, and whether to start it, read by the daemon's start with bun:sqlite, one select over the App table. There is no `mcp` script: nothing calls a verb on the registry, so it composes no module and starts no server. There is no `check` script either: it ran compile.js, deleted 2026-09-29, and removed store.db first, so it would now leave the router serving nothing. A check that cannot run leaves the store in .check as it is, and the router serves it.
